name: io.github.dataplat/dbatools-mcp-server
description: MCP server for dbatools — exposes SQL Server management commands as MCP tools

environmentVariables.name: DBATOOLS_SAFE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: When true, non-readonly commands require confirm:true. This is separate from HTTPS authentication and operator authorization.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_OUTPUT_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of rows returned per command. Defaults to 100. Allowed range: 1–10000.

environmentVariables.name: COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Timeout in seconds for each dbatools command. Defaults to 60. Allowed range: 5–3600.

environmentVariables.name: PWSH_EXE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the PowerShell executable. Defaults to 'pwsh'.

environmentVariables.name: DBATOOLS_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: stdio (default) or https; HTTPS requires Windows-account login.

environmentVariables.name: DBATOOLS_HTTPS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address for HTTPS; defaults to 127.0.0.1.

environmentVariables.name: DBATOOLS_HTTPS_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Required comma-separated exact HTTPS hostnames, without ports.

environmentVariables.name: DBATOOLS_TLS_CERT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to PEM certificate chain; required for HTTPS.

environmentVariables.name: DBATOOLS_TLS_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to PEM private key; required for HTTPS.

environmentVariables.name: DBATOOLS_CREDENTIAL_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Path to Windows DPAPI profile directory.

environmentVariables.name: DBATOOLS_HELP_INDEX
environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute path to the generated help manifest.

environmentVariables.name: DBATOOLS_PERSISTENT_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Persistent process for STDIO (default true). HTTPS always uses one-shot processes.
